project: ShopSure QA — E-Commerce Quality Assurance and API Testing Suite

defects.title: Parameter limit=0 overrides limit to 194 and returns entire catalog
Querying non-existent /orders route returns raw Express HTML rather than standard JSON 404
Login credential failure returns HTTP 400 Bad Request instead of standard HTTP 401 Unauthorized

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify retrieval of all products with standard pagination
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products?limit=5&skip=0; 2. Inspect response status code and payload
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Response returns JSON with 'products' array of length 5, plus 'total', 'skip', and 'limit' metadata
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (1340ms); Received 5 products; limit=5, total=194

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify retrieval of a single product using a valid existing ID
testCases.Preconditions: Product with ID 1 exists in catalog
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/1; 2. Validate product schema and fields
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns product object with matching id=1, valid title, positive price, stock >= 0, rating, and images array
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (607ms); Product id=1 ('Essence Mascara Lash Princess'), price=$9.99, stock=99

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify error response when requesting a non-existent product ID
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/99999; 2. Validate error handling
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Returns JSON error object with message 'Product with id 99999 not found'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (1120ms); Clean error message: 'Product with id '99999' not found'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify boundary handling for negative product ID
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/-1; 2. Validate response status code and body
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Returns JSON error object indicating product not found without server 500 error
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (923ms); Message: 'Product with id '-1' not found'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify boundary handling for non-numeric alphanumeric product ID
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/abc; 2. Inspect error format
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Clean error message indicating product 'abc' not found
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (1124ms); Message: 'Product with id 'abc' not found'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify product search with a valid matching keyword
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/search?q=phone; 2. Check returned products array
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns non-empty products array where items match search term, total > 0
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (885ms); Found 23 items matching 'phone'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify product search with a non-existent search keyword
testCases.Preconditions: Keyword 'xyz987qweNonExistentKey' does not match any item
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/search?q=xyz987qweNonExistentKey; 2. Inspect results
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns empty products array with total=0
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (647ms); Correctly returned empty array; total=0

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify filtering products by valid category slug
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/category/smartphones; 2. Verify all returned products belong to 'smartphones'
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns products array where every product has category='smartphones'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (1070ms); Received 16 items, 100% matched category 'smartphones'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify successful user authentication with valid demo credentials
testCases.Preconditions: Demo user 'emilys' is registered with password 'emilyspass'
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login with valid JSON body; 2. Extract accessToken
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns valid accessToken, refreshToken, user profile (id=1, email, username='emilys')
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (4391ms); JWT accessToken extracted successfully; user id=1, username='emilys'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify authentication failure when providing incorrect password
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login with wrong password; 2. Verify status and error message
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Returns JSON error object with message 'Invalid credentials'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (890ms); Rejected with message 'Invalid credentials' (Ref: BUG-003)

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify authentication failure for non-existent username
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login with non-existent user; 2. Check error handling
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Returns JSON error with message 'Invalid credentials'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (830ms); Correctly rejected non-existent user with 'Invalid credentials'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify validation when password property is omitted from login payload
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login omitting 'password' field; 2. Verify error handling
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Returns message 'Username and password required'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (1011ms); Validation error: 'Username and password required'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify validation when username property is omitted from login payload
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login omitting 'username' field; 2. Verify error handling
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Returns message 'Username and password required'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (872ms); Validation error: 'Username and password required'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify validation when login request body is completely empty
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login with empty JSON object {}; 2. Verify error handling
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Returns message 'Username and password required'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (968ms); Handled empty body with message: 'Username and password required'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify access to protected profile /auth/me with valid Bearer token
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /auth/me with header 'Authorization: Bearer <valid_token>'; 2. Validate response
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns authenticated user profile matching user id=1 and username='emilys'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (1031ms); Authenticated profile retrieved; email='emily.johnson@x.dummyjson.com'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify rejection when accessing protected endpoint with invalid or tampered token
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /auth/me with tampered Bearer token; 2. Verify security rejection
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized; Returns error message 'Invalid/Expired Token!'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (810ms); Protected route rejected tampered token with 'Invalid/Expired Token!'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify rejection when accessing protected endpoint without Authorization header
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /auth/me without Authorization header; 2. Verify security rejection
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized; Returns error message 'Access Token is required'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (918ms); Rejection message: 'Access Token is required'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify retrieval of all shopping carts with pagination
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /carts?limit=5; 2. Validate carts list and pagination metadata
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns carts array of length 5 with total, skip, and limit attributes
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (818ms); Returned 5 carts; total=208

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify retrieval of a single cart by valid ID and validate item calculations
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /carts/1; 2. Assert products array, total, and discountedTotal
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns cart with id=1, products array, positive total, and positive discountedTotal
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (933ms); Cart id=1, totalProducts=4, total=$13037.88, discountedTotal=$11510.81

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify error response when requesting a non-existent cart ID
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /carts/99999; 2. Check error status and message
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Returns JSON error object with message 'Cart with id 99999 not found'
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (811ms); Message: 'Cart with id '99999' not found'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify boundary handling for negative cart ID
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /carts/-1; 2. Verify error status
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Returns clean 404 error message indicating cart not found
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (934ms); Message: 'Cart with id '-1' not found'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify simulated addition of multiple products to a cart and assert quantity totals
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /carts/add with multi-product payload; 2. Verify simulated cart response
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 201 Created; Returns created cart object with totalQuantity=3, products length=2, and calculated total
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 201 Created (703ms); Simulated cart created with 2 line items; totalQuantity=3, calculated total=$39.97

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify simulated cart line-item quantity update
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send PUT request to /carts/1 with updated product quantity; 2. Validate response
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns updated cart calculation reflecting modified product quantity
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (824ms); Cart line item updated; total recomputed to $13087.829999999998

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify simulated cart deletion and isDeleted flag response
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send DELETE request to /carts/1; 2. Verify deletion flags
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Returns cart object containing 'isDeleted': true and a valid 'deletedOn' timestamp
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (722ms); Cart marked deleted; isDeleted=true, deletedOn='2026-10-24T08:23:54.603Z'

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify documented limitation: query non-existent /orders endpoint
testCases.Preconditions: System architecture specification states DummyJSON has no native /orders route
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /orders; 2. Confirm system limitation behavior
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Verifies and documents that /orders route is not supported in the demo API
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (810ms); Confirmed limitation: /orders route is not supported (Ref: BUG-002)

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify documented limitation: query single order by ID /orders/1
testCases.Preconditions: System architecture specification states DummyJSON has no native /orders route
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /orders/1; 2. Confirm system limitation behavior
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Rejection cleanly handled without application crash
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (726ms); Safe rejection for single order lookup without server crash

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify documented limitation: attempt direct checkout via /checkout
testCases.Preconditions: System architecture specification states DummyJSON has no native checkout endpoint
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /checkout with cart ID; 2. Confirm rejection
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found; Handled safely without 500 Internal Server Error
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 404 Not Found (914ms); Unexposed checkout route safely rejected without 500 error

testCases.Test Scenario: Validate pre-checkout order readiness via cart simulation contract
testCases.Preconditions: User 1 is authenticated and items are staged in cart
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Post valid cart item configuration to /carts/add; 2. Validate subtotal and discount formulas for order receipt
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 201 Created; Subtotal and discounted total are mathematically consistent for checkout receipt generation
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 201 Created (1032ms); Order receipt readiness verified: total=$39.97, discountedTotal=$34

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify API response time performance SLA across catalog retrieval
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products?limit=10; 2. Record response latency and assert SLA
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Response latency is strictly below configured threshold (3000 ms)
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (1424ms); Response time 1424ms complies with SLA (< 3000ms)

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify strict JSON schema and primitive data types for product entity
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/1; 2. Validate data types for id, title, price, stock, rating, thumbnail
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; id is number, title is string, price is number, stock is integer, rating is number, thumbnail is string URL
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (714ms); Strict schema validation passed for all entity attributes

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify pagination boundary behavior when limit query parameter is 0
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products?limit=0; 2. Inspect products length and limit attribute
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Per API design, limit=0 returns all available products (total=194, limit=194, products length=194)
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (1353ms); limit=0 returned all 194 items per API specification (Ref: BUG-001)

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify HTTP Content-Type and charset headers compliance
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products/1; 2. Inspect response headers
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Content-Type header contains 'application/json' with utf-8 encoding
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (786ms); Content-Type: 'application/json; charset=utf-8' validated

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify HTTP Connection header and caching control headers integrity
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send GET request to /products; 2. Validate Connection header presence
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK; Connection header is present and valid
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK (732ms); Connection: 'keep-alive' header verified

testCases.Test Scenario: Verify security against SQL Injection patterns in authentication fields
testCases.Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/login with SQL injection payload; 2. Confirm safe rejection
testCases.Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; Safely rejected with 'Invalid credentials' without database error leakage
testCases.Actual Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request (2392ms); SQL injection attempt safely rejected with 'Invalid credentials'
